item.title: Neil Young Cancels European Tour Including Cork Show
item.description: Neil Young has called off his upcoming European tour , including a show in Cork. The singer was fixed to play a run of Summer shows this year, including gigs in the UK and Europe, like Glasgow, Manchester, Woodstock and Cork. But now, he has cancelled the tour with The Chrome Hearts, saying that it is "not the time" for him to be playing live. item.description: Comedian Joe Lycett has finally seen justice after a four-month harassment campaign by his neighbour culminated in a stalking conviction. The defendant, Sam Egerton, who is not widely known outside the local area, repeatedly targeted Lycett, sending threatening messages and loitering outside the comic’s home in what the court described as a “prolonged and disturbing” campaign. item.description: Paris is the city where you're most likely to fall victim to pickpockets.
